recipe.title: Burst cherry tomatoes with eggs, halloumi and toast
recipe.intro: By the middle of July cherry tomatoes ripen faster than anyone can pick them. Blistered in a hot pan, they burst into a sweet sauce for eggs.
utensils: large frying pan with a lid
steps: Heat 1 tbsp of the oil in a large frying pan over a medium high heat. Fry the halloumi for 1 to 2 minutes on each side until golden, then lift onto a plate.
Add the rest of the oil and the cherry tomatoes. Cook for about 5 minutes, shaking the pan now and then, until the skins blister and split and the juices start to run.
Stir in the garlic for the last minute so it softens without browning. Add the vinegar, a small pinch of salt and plenty of pepper. Go easy on salt as the halloumi is salty.
Add the spinach a handful at a time, stirring until it has all wilted into the tomatoes, about 2 minutes.
Make four hollows in the pan and crack an egg into each. Cover and cook gently for 4 to 5 minutes, until the whites are set but the yolks still wobble. Toast the bread meanwhile.
Tuck the halloumi back into the pan for the last minute to warm through. Tear over the basil and serve straight from the pan with the toast.
recipe.tip: No halloumi? Crumble over feta at the end instead, or leave the cheese out and add a second egg each.
